areas.title: Areas
areas.description: First select the rooms to monitor. Rooms with Window-class binary sensors are preselected; covers do not count. Next, review window-sensor exclusions. If these remove all usable contacts from a selected room, you can review your rooms again.

data.use_mold_indicator: Use mold indication instead of raw room RH

data_description.areas: Rooms first. Window-class binary sensors only; covers do not count. Exclusions are reviewed next, with a room review if needed.
data_description.use_mold_indicator: When enabled, humidity recommendations use the estimated relative humidity at each room's coldest surface instead of raw RH. Calibrate each room under the Room settings menu; an uncalibrated room remains unknown rather than safe.

window_sensors.title: Window sensor exclusions
window_sensors.description: Review window-class binary sensors. ⚠ marks likely virtual or auxiliary signals (for example window-open detection on a radiator thermostat); those are preselected for exclusion. Uncheck any real window contact. Your choices are saved and take priority over future suggestions.

data_description.excluded_window_entities: The menu lists every Window-class binary sensor with its room and entity ID. Selected entities will not count as windows for room selection, recommendations or the dashboard. An empty selection includes them all.

indoor_sensors.title: Room settings — indoor air and mold
indoor_sensors.description:
Room: {area_name} ({position}/{total}). Exclude indoor air sensors here. For mold indication, measure the temperature of the coldest surface (for example an exterior corner or window frame) with a thermometer while room and outdoor temperatures are stable. Enter the surface temperature in °C below. Leave it empty to calibrate later.

{mold_room_notice}

data.excluded_indoor_entities: Sensors to exclude in this room
data.mold_indoor_temperature: Room temperature sensor for mold calibration
data.mold_recalibrate: Recalibrate with current room and outdoor readings

data_description.excluded_indoor_entities: Selected sensors are ignored in recommendations and the dashboard for this room only. Humidity, CO₂, AQI, PM2.5, PM10 and VOC sensors are supported. An empty selection keeps them all.
data_description.mold_indoor_temperature: Choose the ambient room temperature sensor (°C/°F). Only supported temperature sensors assigned to this room are offered. The reading is captured together with the outdoor weather temperature when you save a new calibration.
data_description.mold_critical_temperature_c: Measure the coldest wall/corner/window-frame surface now, simultaneously with room and outdoor temperature. A difference of at least 3°C between indoors and outdoors is needed. This measurement sets a persistent calibration factor; it is not treated as a fixed surface temperature. Clear to disable mold estimation for this room. See the Home Assistant Mold Indicator documentation.
data_description.mold_recalibrate: Check only after measuring the coldest surface again now. Otherwise changing sensor exclusions must not silently overwrite the original calibration.

outdoor.title: Outdoor air quality
outdoor.description: Choose one or more supported outdoor air-quality sensors. Valid high readings block ventilation. Unknown, stale or unavailable readings are ignored as blockers and shown separately as incomplete data.

data_description.outdoor_sensors: Choose genuine outdoor sensors. Available readings above limits block opening; unknown, unavailable or stale readings are reported, not classified as unsafe.

weather.title: Weather and warnings
weather.description:
Select weather providers and, optionally, weather-warning sensors. Rain, storms, excessive wind, extreme temperatures and active or unavailable warnings block opening. An unavailable selected provider is treated cautiously.

{mold_weather_notice}

data_description.weather_entities: At least one weather provider. Rain, storms and extreme wind/temperature block opening. Mold indication uses the current temperature attribute (°C/°F) of a selected weather entity for outdoor temperature. Choose a source that reports temperature.
data_description.weather_warnings: Optional. Active and unavailable selected warnings block window opening.

delivery.title: Announcements (optional)
delivery.description: The recommendation sensor always works without announcements. Enable notifications and/or speech only if wanted. Announcement Hub, when enabled and available, handles room-aware routing. For standalone output, choose notification targets and a TTS engine with players.

data_description.language: Choose auto for Home Assistant’s language; the manual action can override it.
data_description.automatic_tts: Disabled by default. New open recommendations need 90 seconds of stable conditions.
data_description.automatic_notifications: Disabled by default. No repeated alerts on every sensor reading.
data_description.use_announcement_hub: Only shown when Announcement Hub is configured. When stopped, unavailable or rejecting a job, the advisor falls back to Home Assistant notification/TTS and a persistent notification if needed.
data_description.notify_entities: Direct outputs when Announcement Hub is not used.
data_description.tts_engine: Direct speech provider when Announcement Hub is not used.
data_description.media_players: Direct audio destinations; room assignment controls targeting.
data_description.announcement_repeat_minutes: Default 10 minutes. Set to 0 to never repeat. The same window recommendation and reason must still apply. Each room has its own timer; sensor fluctuations above the same limit do not reset it. Requires automatic notifications or TTS.
data_description.ai_rewrite_announcements: One option for both paths. When Announcement Hub is selected, send use_ai: true/false to its action; otherwise rewrite direct Home Assistant notifications/TTS. The recommendation itself stays deterministic.
data_description.ai_conversation_agent: Home Assistant default is preselected. A custom agent overrides the Hub agent or is used for direct rewriting; default inherits Hub's own agent when Hub is selected.

thresholds.title: Advanced thresholds
thresholds.description: These limits apply to instantaneous sensor values and are configurable guidance, not health or exposure standards. AQI assumes the US 0–500 scale by default; change the limits for any differently scaled provider.

data.max_age_minutes: Maximum age of any outdoor reading (minutes)
data.indoor_mold: Mold indication triggering ventilation (estimated surface RH, %)

error.invalid_weather: Select at least one weather entity.
error.invalid_warning: A weather-warning sensor is no longer supported.
error.missing_notify: Enable Announcement Hub or choose a notification entity.
error.missing_tts: Enable Announcement Hub or select a TTS engine and media player.
error.temperature_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum.
error.no_window_areas: No areas with window contacts were found. Assign a binary sensor with device class Window to a Home Assistant area; covers do not count.
error.invalid_areas: An area is no longer available as a window area.
error.invalid_window_exclusions: One or more excluded entities are no longer in the list.
error.invalid_indoor_exclusions: A selected indoor sensor is not in this room’s supported list.
error.no_windows_after_exclusions: These exclusions would leave no usable window contacts. Keep at least one contact included.
error.review_areas_after_exclusions: Some selected rooms lost their last window contact after exclusions. Please review your rooms.
error.invalid_repeat_minutes: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1440 minutes (0 disables repeats).
error.missing_ai_service: The Home Assistant conversation.process action is unavailable.
error.invalid_ai_agent: Select a supported Home Assistant conversation agent.
error.invalid_mold_temperature_sensor: Choose a valid temperature sensor assigned to this room.
error.missing_mold_indoor_temperature: The room temperature sensor has no valid recent Celsius/Fahrenheit reading. Try again when it is available.
error.missing_mold_outdoor_temperature: No selected weather entity supplies a valid recent outdoor temperature. Configure weather first or wait for a valid measurement.
error.invalid_mold_surface_temperature: Enter a finite measured surface temperature in °C.
error.invalid_mold_calibration: Calibration needs room, outdoor and cold-surface temperatures measured together, with at least 3°C difference between room and outside. Check the three readings.

data_description.pollen_max_scale: For example 5 for a 0–5 scale. The numerical maximum is specific to your provider.
data_description.pollen_avoid_ventilation: If enabled, a high trusted pollen reading becomes an outside blocker. Leave off unless this is appropriate for your household.

environment_room.title: Choose a room for environmental science
environment_room.description: Configure extra sensors and assumptions for one selected room. All are optional. The basic Home Environment Manager features work without any of them.

data_description.environment_area: Only the selected room is edited. Return here to configure another room.

environment_room_air.title: Room: {area_name} — ventilation and moisture
environment_room_air.description: Optional. Choose the room-temperature sensor if multiple are present. Enter measured room volume and your air cleaner's published particle CADR only if known. Confirm real NDIR CO₂ hardware before allowing predictions. Room occupancy and open-window evidence still determine whether air-change estimates are possible.

data.co2_ndir_verified: CO₂ sensor has verified real NDIR hardware

data_description.temperature_entity: When multiple temperature sensors are available, explicitly choose the correctly located one. A mold calibration sensor is otherwise reused.
data_description.room_volume_m3: Interior usable volume: room floor area × ceiling height. Required for nominal filter air exchanges.
data_description.particle_cadr_m3h: Use the manufacturer's rated particle CADR at the stated fan speed, not fan airflow or a guessed air-change rate. Does not apply to gases.
data_description.purifier_entity: Power state is used for descriptive suggestions only; Home Environment Manager does not control the device.
data_description.extractor_entity: Enables moisture-event advice about extraction. RH rises alone do not prove a shower or cooking event.
data_description.co2_ndir_verified: Use only independently confirmed true CO₂ hardware, not TVOC-based eCO₂ estimates.
data_description.co2_target_ppm: A configurable operational ventilation goal; reaching it does not prove healthy air or absence of infection risk.
data_description.sleep_room: Adds sleeping-room interpretation of nighttime heat and noise history when adequate data exists.

environment_room_exposure.title: Room: {area_name} — optional specialist sensors
environment_room_exposure.description: Optional. Select only sensors actually measuring the requested pollutant and units. Confirm independent hardware/calibration; synthetic HCHO, eCO₂ and generic sound-level signals are not acceptable substitutes for validated observations. Radon guidelines need nearly a full year of history.

data.radon_sensor_verified: Radon sensor uses dedicated calibrated hardware
data.formaldehyde_sensor_verified: Formaldehyde measurement is real and verified
data.noise_sensor_calibrated: Sound-level sensor delivers equivalent calibrated readings
data.melanopic_spectral_verified: Melanopic EDI comes from a real spectral measurement

data_description.radon_entity: Dedicated monitor, Bq/m³ or pCi/L. WHO recommends a national annual reference of 100 Bq/m³ where feasible (not above 300).
data_description.radon_sensor_verified: Acknowledges the device truly measures radon. Annual comparison remains unavailable until enough measured days exist.
data_description.radon_reference_bq_m3: Choose a reference appropriate to your jurisdiction; 100 Bq/m³ is WHO's recommended target where feasible, national limits vary.
data_description.formaldehyde_entity: Dedicated HCHO with µg/m³ or mg/m³ readings. A generic Tuya estimated HCHO signal is unsuitable.
data_description.formaldehyde_sensor_verified: Required before comparing a measured 30-minute average against WHO's 100 µg/m³ guideline.
data_description.noise_entity: A-weighted dB(A). The integration performs logarithmic energy averaging, not arithmetic dB averaging.
data_description.noise_sensor_calibrated: Only enable if your sensor represents sampled equivalent sound levels; peak-only recordings cannot make an LAeq.
data_description.illuminance_entity: Standard lux; daylight exposure only, not circadian or melanopic effectiveness.
data_description.melanopic_edi_entity: Requires actual melanopic equivalent daylight illuminance from a spectral sensor, never an estimated conversion from lux.
data_description.melanopic_spectral_verified: Confirms the selected sensor measures melanopic EDI. The integration does not infer this from correlated color temperature.

environment_room_comfort.title: Room: {area_name} — full thermal comfort (advanced)
environment_room_comfort.description: Optional ISO 7730 PMV/PPD. You MUST provide mean radiant temperature, air speed (measured or supplied), activity in met and clothing insulation in clo. Never interpret estimates as individual comfort or building compliance.

data_description.enable_pmv: Off by default to avoid invented clothing, radiant temperature, activity and air speed.
data_description.radiant_temperature_entity: Measured mean radiant temperature, not an ordinary ambient temperature sensor in the same room.
data_description.air_speed_entity: If selected, use an actual m/s sensor; this overrides the static entered air speed.
data_description.air_speed_m_s: Only enter when you can justify an air-speed assumption; the output will be labeled an estimate.
data_description.met: For example approximately 1.0 sitting quietly or 1.2 for desk work; choose the occupant's real activity.
data_description.clo: Clothing insulation chosen for the occupant, e.g. 0.5 light summer clothing and 1.0 winter clothing.

pid.title: Climate PID — select a room
pid.description: Optional and disabled by default. Choose exactly one monitored room. A room's PID never controls climate devices in a different assigned Home Assistant area.

data_description.pid_area: Only that room's explicitly selected climate entities may be controlled.

pid_room.title: Climate PID in {area_name} — devices and comfort target
pid_room.description: Enable PID only after selecting real room temperature measurements and the climate devices you authorize. The existing thermostat must already be in heat or cool mode. Windows with open or unknown contacts stop PID commands. No HVAC mode or compressor switching is performed.

data.pid_enabled: Enable supervisory climate PID for this room
data.pid_pause_on_window_open: Pause when any room window is open or unknown

data_description.pid_enabled: Off by default. Enable only after verifying the temperature sensor, climate devices and safe setpoint range.
data_description.pid_climate_entities: Select the exact thermostats in this room. This controller will not broadcast to a device, area or entire integration.
data_description.pid_temperature_entity: Required. Fresh reading no older than 10 minutes; unavailable or stale values stop control. °C/°F supported.
data_description.pid_mode: Choose heat or cool to match the device's current mode. PID never powers on HVAC or changes modes.
data_description.pid_target_c: The requested room temperature, not a compressor duty cycle or proof of thermal comfort.
data_description.pid_pause_on_window_open: Strongly recommended. No thermostat commands while the selected room's window contacts are open or unavailable.

pid_tuning.title: Climate PID in {area_name} — advanced safety and tuning
pid_tuning.description: Kp in %/°C, Ki in %/(°C·minute), Kd in %·minute/°C. The output only trims the existing thermostat setpoint within a bounded range, at limited intervals. Start with defaults; tune gradually after reviewing room trends. Manual setpoint changes pause PID until you explicitly resume it.

data_description.pid_kp: Start with default 22. High values may cause undesirable thermostat setpoint hunting.
data_description.pid_ki: Start with 0.25. Conditional anti-windup stops integration at saturated limits.
data_description.pid_kd: Default 0. Derivative is based on the filtered measured temperature, avoiding a setpoint kick.
data_description.pid_offset_c: Full PID demand moves heating setpoint up by this offset or cooling setpoint down by this offset; no HVAC mode switching.
data_description.pid_min_setpoint_c: Hard operational floor; device min/max are additional hard limits.
data_description.pid_max_setpoint_c: Hard operational ceiling; device min/max are additional hard limits.
data_description.pid_sample_seconds: At least 120 seconds. A 300-second cycle is the conservative default; no repeated commands on every sensor event.
data_description.pid_max_change_c: Setpoint rate limiter. Defaults to 0.5 °C per control cycle and cannot be bypassed by a large error.
data_description.pid_min_change_c: Avoids needless chatter from small temperature differences or device quantization.

climate.title: Climate — select room
climate.description: Configure each selected room independently. A fresh room temperature sensor and exact room-assigned actuators are required. Direct relay/PWM is permitted only for independently protected non-compressor loads, with confirmed on/off limits and explicit actuation opt-in. Occupied, unoccupied, away and sleep heating/cooling targets are independent.
